review.why: Reviews docs against a writing handbook fetched from a Vercel URL, with terse file:line findings.
review.summary: Fetches the latest writing guidelines from a raw GitHub URL before each review, reads the files the user names and reports findings in the terse file:line format defined by the fetched text. The skill itself contains no rules.
strengths: Rules stay current because they are fetched each time
Terse file:line output suits editors and CI-style review
Asks which files to review when none are given
cautions: The rules are not in the skill: they come from a remote URL
Remote text becomes the agent's instructions and can change without notice
Useless offline or if the URL moves
